Answers below.

**h01.** `s3presign.Runner` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`), which re-presigns S3 object URLs before they expire — `CheckAndPresign` refreshes any attachment whose `LastPresignedTime` is older than 4 days (URLs are issued with 5-day expiry) — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:47-132`.
- Schedule: every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`; ticker loop at `:29-41`), plus one immediate `RunOnce` at boot.
- Wiring: `Server.startBackgroundRunners` — `server/server.go:162` (construct), `server/server.go:163` (`RunOnce`), `server/server.go:167-170` (goroutine running `Run`); called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02.** Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (actual send at `:152` via `safeClient.Do`); async wrapper `PostAsync` (`:184`) feeds a 128-slot queue drained by 4 goroutines (`:39`, `:42-55`).
Protection: SSRF guard in the shared client's transport — `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`) resolves the host and rejects any address in a reserved/private range (`isReservedIP`), which also defeats DNS rebinding; wired at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:32-37`.

**h03.** Abstraction package: `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:1`, defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo`). Implementation package: `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:1-42`, `IdentityProvider` + `NewIdentityProvider`) — OAuth2 only; no other protocol implementation ships.

**h04.** No. `mysql.NewDB` is referenced exactly once in the repo, inside the factory: `store/db/db.go:22`. Repo-wide grep for `NewDB(` yields only `store/db/db.go:20/22/24`, the three declarations (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20`, `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:21`, `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:24`), and two test call sites that use `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/deployment_config_test.go:416`, `store/demo_seed_test.go:24`). No `mysql.DB` literal construction elsewhere.

**h05.** Mechanism: explicit Go code inside the `DeleteUser` transaction — not a DB rule.
- `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:94` (`deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx`, impl `:352-360`) and `:100` (`deleteReactionsByCreatorTx`, impl `:372-375`); same in `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:96,102` and `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:96,102`.
- Evidence against a DB-level rule: the `reaction` table has no foreign keys (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`; the only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in the schema is `memo_share.memo_id` at `:109`), and SQLite is opened with FKs disabled (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`, `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)`).

**h06.** Handlers (all `APIV1Service` RPCs):
- `CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` → `:157` `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`
- `UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` → `:513` `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`
- `DeleteMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` → `:562` `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` → `:119` `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`
- `SetMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16` → `:48`
- `SetMemoRelations` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16` → `:48`

Convergence: all paths funnel through `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`) into the single delivery function `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`.

**h07.**
- Route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `store.Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks `userCache` only for ID lookups)
- `store.Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` → `s.driver.ListUsers` (`:137`)
- `sqlite.DB.ListUsers` — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (SQL `SELECT`; postgres/mysql equivalents exist)
- Back in the handler: `parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:194` — the avatar is stored as a data URI in `user.avatar_url` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:20`), then blobbed out at `:207`.

**h08.** Two declarers:
- `*s3presign.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked? yes — callers: `server/server.go:163` (production startup) and `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` (its own ticker loop).
- `*memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked? no — no callers anywhere (test or production); only `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used, from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**h09.** Count: 6 concrete method declarations (plus one interface method declaration, `cache.Interface.Close` at `store/cache/cache.go:31`):
`store.Store.Close` (`store/store.go:72`), `cache.Cache.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `sqlite.DB.Close` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `postgres.DB.Close` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `mysql.DB.Close` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`), `v1.SSEHub.Close` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`).

Called by non-test server code:
- `store.Store.Close` — caller `server/server.go:146`
- `v1.SSEHub.Close` — caller `server/server.go:206`
- `cache.Cache.Close` — callers `store/store.go:74,75,76`
- driver `Close` via the `store.Driver` interface — caller `store/store.go:78`; with the default install this dispatches to `sqlite.DB.Close` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`). `postgres.DB.Close` / `mysql.DB.Close` are reachable only under those driver settings, never called directly.

**h10.** `(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — ~28 inbound call sites (29 textual occurrences minus the declaration), all within `internal/filter/render.go`. Runner-up: `Schema.Field` (`internal/filter/schema.go:67`) with ~19 callers across `internal/filter/parser.go` and `render.go`. (Ambiguous shared names like `New`/`Error`/`Info` were excluded as they resolve to stdlib/`slog`, not `internal/`.)

**h11.** 1st: `store.User` — referenced from 9 packages outside `store` (`server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/rss`, plus `store/db/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}`).
2nd: `store.Memo` — 7 packages (`server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`, plus the three `store/db/*` drivers). Next is `store.Attachment` at 6.

**h12.** Concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (the `INSERT INTO memo ... RETURNING` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:39-40`).
Determination: the driver flag defaults to `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` viper default and `:130` flag default) → `profile.Driver` (`cmd/memos/main.go:43`) → `db.NewDBDriver` switch selects `sqlite.NewDB` (`store/db/db.go:20`) → that value is the `store.Driver` in `store.New` (`cmd/memos/main.go:57,64`; `store/store.go:37`). The RPC path `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`) calls `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go`), which delegates to `s.driver.CreateMemo` — so the interface hop resolves to the sqlite implementation. The postgres/mysql `CreateMemo` methods are the other candidates, unreachable without `--driver`.

**h13.** Interface: `markdown.Service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`.
- Impl: the unexported `*markdown.service` (goldmark-backed) — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-59`; it is the only implementation.
- Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85-111`, returning `&service{md: goldmark.New(...)}` at `:108`. Production construction site: `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` (test helper: `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`).
- Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, ctor `:58`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`); also passed as a parameter to `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).

**h14.** Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which calls `markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`) and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` (`:85-86`).
Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), and `UpdateMemo` when the `content` field mask is applied (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`). The bulk backfill path `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72`) also recomputes it, but is not wired into startup (see h08).
Extracted properties: tags (`#tag` nodes, excluding those inside links/images), and `MemoPayload_Property` = `HasLink`, `HasTaskList`, `HasCode`, `HasIncompleteTasks`, `Title` (first H1) — `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-95`, populated at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:376-400+`. (Mentions are also extracted by `ExtractAll` but not stored in the payload.) The separate plain-text `Snippet` used in previews is generated by `getMemoContentSnippet` → `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`).

**h15.** Distinct enforcement sites:
- `APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (GetMemo path) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68` (`:55`, `:63`)
- `APIV1Service.ListMemos` visibility filtering — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219`, `:225`
- `FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:674-700` (`:677`, `:699`)
- Attachment RPC access check — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445`, `:451`
- `ListMemoAttachments` check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214`, `:222`
- Reaction service (list/upsert/delete) — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30`, `:38`, `:83`
- Comment creation/listing — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`, `:100`
- SSE broadcast filtering — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:136-138`
- RSS feeds (public only) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90`, `:141`
- Frontend SSR/meta injection (public only) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- User stats RPCs — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84`, `:90`, `:218`, `:220`
- Mention/notification targeting — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62`, `:67`, `:84`; email notifications `server/notification/email.go:313`, `:316`; `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309`, `:312`

**r01.** Premise is wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in the codebase (no Redis import in `go.mod`, no Redis reference in any `.go` file). Caching is a process-local in-memory cache: `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache` struct at `:66`, `New` at `:75`). Three caches are created in `store.New` — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` (`store/store.go:47-51`) — all sharing one config with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, `CleanupInterval: 5 * time.Minute`, `MaxItems: 1000` (`store/store.go:39-44`; same defaults at `store/cache/cache.go:57-64`). So user entries expire 10 minutes after write; they are also invalidated explicitly on user update/delete (`store/user.go:179`).

**r02.** Premise is wrong: there is no rate-limiting middleware, per-user or otherwise. A repo-wide search for `ratelimit`/`rate_limit`/`RateLimiter`/`golang.org/x/time/rate` in Go sources returns nothing, and `go.mod` has no rate-limit dependency. The only Echo middleware registered is `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-52`), plus static-file/SPA-fallback middleware in the frontend router (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:54,59`) and auth middleware on the gRPC-Gateway mux (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:95-97`). The nearest concurrency limits are unrelated: a thumbnail semaphore (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:107`) and the 128-slot webhook queue with 4 workers (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-55`).

**r03.** Premise is wrong: there is no cron scheduler running in the server and no nightly database-cleanup job. A generic cron package exists (`internal/scheduler/`, e.g. `scheduler.go:54` `New`, `:91` `Start`, `parser.go:30` `ParseCronExpression`) but it is never imported outside its own package — it is dead code as far as the server is concerned. The only background work wired into startup is the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/server.go:153-175`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41`), which is not cron-scheduled and does no cleanup.

**r04.** Premise is wrong: there is no message broker — neither NATS nor RabbitMQ (no such dependency in `go.mod`, no reference in any source file), and no queue is declared anywhere. Actual mechanism: an in-process buffered Go channel. `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) is drained by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`), each calling `Post` (`:120`). `PostAsync` (`:184`) does a non-blocking send and drops the delivery with a warning when the buffer is full (`:189-195`). Nothing is persisted or retried.

**r05.** Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL server in this codebase (no `graphql` reference in any `.go` or `.proto` file, none in `go.mod`). The public API is Protobuf/gRPC-defined: service definitions live in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` with generated code in `proto/gen/api/v1/`. It is exposed two ways over the same Echo HTTP server — Connect RPC handlers (`server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:31-45`, for `InstanceService`, `AuthService`, `UserService`, `MemoService`, `AttachmentService`, `AIService`, `ShortcutService`, `IdentityProviderService`) and a gRPC-Gateway REST mux (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:95-120`). Additional non-RPC surfaces: the file server (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:122-125`) and RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`).
